text:
Send one text message without handing callers the Telnyx key. The body is {to,text} or <to> <text>. An unknown result is never retried; start with send.
send <to> <text...>: Send one SMS. Accepted means the provider accepted it, not that it arrived; never retry an unknown result.
  to (string): E.164 destination or configured alias
  text (string): Message, 1 to 1600 characters
